name: LearnBridge
shortDescription: Offline-first e-learning platform for learners with unreliable internet access.
features: Course catalogue with metadata, search and filters
Lessons with mixed content blocks and configurable completion requirements
Quizzes (mcq, multi-select, true/false, short answer) with explanations
Progress states driven by requirements, not page views
Downloadable course packs for low-bandwidth study
Offline sync queue with explicit conflict resolution
knownLimitations: PWA service-worker shell represented by course packs + sync API in this MVP
Media links open only online; offline availability never claimed
